description: What one part of a session observed (BUILD-PLAN F55).

items.description: What the session observed that the repository does not record, as few items as say it.

statement.description: One sentence, in plain present tense, that stands on its own, calling the user "the user" and the agent "the agent".

quote.description: Words copied from one entry, which the script finds in that entry or drops the item.

entry.description: The label of the entry the quote comes from, such as #3.

term.description: long or short; short when unsure
